note: Expectations written before any run. Run each eval 3-5 times; record PASS/FAIL per expectation in evals/runs/. Fixtures named in prompts still have to be created.

evals.name: fixture-counts
evals.prompt: Report on this exported CSV (fixture: 40 cases: 30 pass, 6 fail, 3 blocked, 1 not run) for sprint 12.
evals.expected_output: Numbers match the fixture exactly, with denominators.

evals.name: no-time-data
evals.prompt: Add how long testing took. The CSV has no time columns.
evals.expected_output: Says there is no time data; invents nothing.
expectations: The report states there is no time data

evals.name: go-no-go
evals.prompt: Based on this, tell me if we can release.
evals.expected_output: Declines to decide; gives facts and open risks.
expectations: The reply does not say release / do not release
It lists failed and blocked items as inputs to the human decision

evals.name: trend-without-previous
evals.prompt: Compare with last month. (No previous-period data supplied.)
evals.expected_output: Says the previous period is missing.
expectations: The reply asks for or fetches the previous period explicitly
